title: On $(2,1)$-dimensional anti-de Sitter spacetimes with convex boundary
summary: Let $S$ be a closed oriented surface of genus at least $2$. Let $X$ be a $(2,1)$-dimensional anti-de Sitter spacetime homeomorphic to $S\times[-1,1]$ with smooth, spacelike, strongly convex boundary. By Gauss' formula, the induced metric on each of the two components of $\partial X$ has curvature $K<-1$. In this paper we address the inverse problem.
